name: aibackman
description: Unified AI conversation archive and backup manager

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:oom: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && AIBACKMAN_OOM_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_DIAGNOSTIC_MODE=diagnostic-build NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:oom:tracegc: concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && AIBACKMAN_OOM_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_TRACE_GC=1 AIBACKMAN_DIAGNOSTIC_MODE=diagnostic-build NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/write-build-info.cjs --mode release-minimal
scripts.build:observable: tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/write-build-info.cjs --mode release-observable
scripts.build:debug: tsc -b && AIBACKMAN_DEBUG_BUILD=1 vite build && node scripts/write-build-info.cjs --mode diagnostic-build
scripts.electron:release:observable: npm run build:observable && AIBACKMAN_DIAGNOSTICS=1 AIBACKMAN_DIAGNOSTIC_MODE=release-observable NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.electron:release:debug: npm run build:debug && AIBACKMAN_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_DIAGNOSTICS=1 AIBACKMAN_DIAGNOSTIC_MODE=diagnostic-build AIBACKMAN_REMOTE_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_CHROMIUM_LOGGING=1 ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 ELECTRON_ENABLE_STACK_DUMPING=1 NODE_ENV=production electron --inspect=9229 .
scripts.electron:release:debug:bridge: npm run build:debug && AIBACKMAN_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_DIAGNOSTICS=1 AIBACKMAN_DIAGNOSTIC_MODE=diagnostic-build AIBACKMAN_REMOTE_DEBUG=1 AIBACKMAN_CHROMIUM_LOGGING=1 AIBACKMAN_BRIDGE_VISIBLE=1 ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 ELECTRON_ENABLE_STACK_DUMPING=1 NODE_ENV=production electron --inspect=9229 .
scripts.test:archive: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/test-archive-imports.cjs && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/test-chatgpt-live.cjs && ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron scripts/test-archive-safety.cjs && npm run test:conversation-ordering
scripts.test:debuggability: npm run validate:debuggability && npm run test:diagnostics && npm run test:archive:safety && npm run test:debuggability:performance
